simple.meaning: כְּתֹבֶת (kᵉthôbeth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a letter or other mark branded on the skin.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 19:28. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a letter or other mark branded on the skin
definitions.full: H3793. kethobeth כְּתֹ֫בֶת noun feminine only construct בָּכֶם תִתְּנוּ לֹא קַעֲקַע וּכְתֹבֶת Lev 19:28 i.e. a writing (mark or sign) of imprintment , scriptio stigmatis, perhaps of tattooing, compare Di (see also Ba NB 61 ).

occurrences.englishText: “ ‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.
